column1: # manifests/vendor-aliases.tsv -- vendor apt aliases used to DISCOVER a browser deb.
# Alias for discovery, store for reproducibility: build/refresh-vendor-debs.sh resolves the
# newest version of <package> in the vendor's signed apt index (signature checked against
# <keyring>, whose primary key fingerprints must equal <key_fprs>), downloads it, checks the
# sha256 and size listed in that index, stages it under <store_dir>/ and records the resolved
# version, URL and sha256 in manifests/vendor-debs.tsv, manifests/build-inputs.tsv and
# sbom/expected-assets.txt. Image builds never read the alias: they consume the staged store
# file, whose sha256 is pinned in git.
# Columns (TAB): package, repo_url, suite, component, index (inrelease = signed InRelease,
# release = Release + detached Release.gpg), keyring (repo path), key_fprs (comma-separated
# primary fingerprints), store_dir, arches (comma-separated), vendor, role.
